other_conditions: Applicant must be a domicile of Jharkhand
Applicant must be a child of a worker registered with the Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)
Scholarship can be availed by up to two children of the registered worker
Applicant must have passed the previous examination with at least Second Division or 45% marks (except classes 1st to 5th) or be admitted on the basis of a competitive examination
benefits_summary: Provides scholarships ranging from ₹5,000 for classes 1‑8 up to ₹50,000 for engineering and medical graduate courses.
